payload.name: Verbal Fluency
payload.fact: Verbal fluency is a cognitive domain that can be impaired in clinical populations such as those with Parkinson's disease or autism spectrum conditions.
payload.boundary: Verbal fluency performance is often measured using semantic fluency tasks, such as the Animal Naming Test.

provenance.title: Grading the range of hepatic encephalopathy from overt to covert: Animals to the rescue!
provenance.quote_or_locus: ANT is a semantic fluency test that can appraise the cognitive functions impaired in the early stages of HE, mainly executive functions

provenance.title: Parallel Cognitive Aging in Autism Spectrum Conditions (ASC): A Replication Study
provenance.quote_or_locus: we replicated earlier observed difficulties in ToM and verbal fluency which seem to persist at older age
